title: Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024: second stage, children
excerpt: Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024: second stage, children
body_html:
“Children learn from adults’ example, not from their words”

Exceptional matches and battles to the wire, glorious wins and bitter defeats, the coaches’ support and emotions, new friendships — these are just some of the unforgettable moments of the Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024 tournament (Stage II / children).

P.S. “We can talk endlessly about great achievements and successes as long as we have happy children beside us!”
